The '''cybernetic eyes Mod III''' were a model of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]] available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The eyes were produced by [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]], and considered one of their finest achievements as there were no errors visible to observers despite the eyes clearly being artificial, a feat incredibly hard to achieve with cybernetic eyes. The eyes cost 7500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="EOTEC" /> to install and increased a user's visual acuity and recognition.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cybernetic eyes Mod III was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
